snippet.title: My Son, Michael Jackson | Joe Jackson In His Own Words | Full Documentary (4K 2160p) | the detail.
snippet.description:
In these rare and emotional interviews, Joe Jackson, the father of Michael Jackson, shares his personal reflections on his son, their complicated relationship, and the heartbreak of being shut out of Michael’s life. Speaking candidly, Joe discusses the pain of distance created by fame, security, and the people who surrounded Michael during his later years.

This video offers a unique and intimate perspective on the man behind the King of Pop, told by someone who knew him before the world did. Joe reflects on family life, the challenges of raising children in the spotlight, and the deep personal cost of fame on both father and son. With honest, sometimes painful recollections, Joe Jackson reveals the emotional truths of being part of one of the most famous families in music history. It is a rare glimpse into the legacy, love, and regret surrounding Michael Jackson, shared in his own words.
